'''Tara Suzanne Holm''' is a [[mathematician]] at [[Cornell University]] specializing in [[algebraic geometry]] and [[symplectic geometry]].<ref name=homepage>{{cite web|url=https://www.math.cornell.edu/~tsh/|title=Home page of Tara S. Holm|location=Cornell University|accessdate=Feb 2, 2015}}</ref>

==Life and career==
Holm graduated summa cum laude from [[Dartmouth College]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Tara Holm, Timothy Riley|date = Oct 31, 2008|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2008/11/02/fashion/weddings/02HOLM.html?_r=0|newspaper=New York Times|accessdate=Feb 2, 2015}}</ref> Holm received her Ph.D. from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 2002 under the supervision of [[Victor Guillemin]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=64847|title=Tara Suzanne Holm}}</ref> She went on to a three-year postdoc at the [[University of California, Berkeley]], before eventually joining the faculty at [[Cornell University|Cornell]].

==Awards and honors==
In 2012, Holm became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society]</ref>

In 2013, Holm was awarded a [[Simons Foundation|Simons Fellowship]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/2013-simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|title=2013 Simons Fellows Awardees: Mathematics|accessdate=Feb 2, 2015|location=[[Simons Foundation]]|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20150104134232/https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/2013-simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|archivedate=January 4, 2015}}</ref>

In 2019, Holm was awarded the Sze/Hernandez Teaching prize at Cornell.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://as.cornell.edu/szehernandez-teaching-prize#recipients|title=Sze/Hernandez Teaching Prize {{!}} Cornell University College of Arts and Sciences Cornell Arts & Sciences|website=as.cornell.edu|access-date=2019-10-06}}</ref>

In 2019, Holm was the [[AWM/MAA Falconer Lecturer]] at MAA MathFest.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://awm-math.org/meetings/awm-mathfest/awm-at-mathfest-2019/|title=AWM at MAA MathFest 2019|website=awm-math.org|access-date=2020-01-17}}</ref>

From 2011-2013, Holm was an [[American Mathematical Society]] Council member at large,<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMS Committees |url=http://www.ams.org/about-us/governance/committees/mal-past.html |access-date=2023-03-29 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref> and from 2013-2016 she was a member of the American Mathematical Society Executive Committee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMS Committees |url=http://www.ams.org/about-us/governance/committees/ec-past.html |access-date=2026-01-09 |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en}}</ref>

==Personal life==
Holm is married to Timothy Riley, also a mathematics professor at Cornell.<ref name="z999">{{cite web | title=Tara Holm, Timothy Riley | website=The New York Times | date=2008-11-01 | url=https://www.nytimes.com/2008/11/02/fashion/weddings/02HOLM.html }}</ref> Through her marriage, she is a member of the [[Cobbold family]].<ref name="t715">{{cite web | title=Biographies {{!}} Tara Suzanne HOLM (#5106) - The Cobbold Family History Trust | website=family-tree.cobboldfht.com | url=https://family-tree.cobboldfht.com/biographies/5106/tara-suzanne-holm }}</ref>
